aboutpara: I create print, outdoor and social campaigns with Higgsfield AI and Adobe Illustrator, building on a background in UI/UX design and corporate business. My work is guided by consistency, accessibility and simplicity: I prioritize stakeholder requirements and user needs while keeping designs clean and aesthetic.

testimonial.quote: Mila combines exceptional artistic talent with a keen understanding of business requirements. Her designs are not only visually stunning but also highly functional and user-focused. Her ability to translate stakeholder needs into elegant design solutions sets her apart in the field of UI/UX design.
testimonial.author: Digital Marketing Agency

about.tagline: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer with a background in corporate business

sections.label: Professional Summary
sections.title: Graphic Designer & UI/UX Designer
sections.body: I'm a Graphic Designer creating print, outdoor and social campaigns with Higgsfield AI and Adobe Illustrator. Before moving into graphic design I spent years on UI/UX training and freelance and agency work, and before that I worked in procurement at IBM and sales at Cisco. That mix gives me a strong eye for visuals together with a clear understanding of business requirements, stakeholders and deadlines.

sections.label: Design Philosophy
sections.title: Consistency, Accessibility, Simplicity
sections.body: Focused on consistency, accessibility, and simplicity. I prioritize stakeholder requirements and user needs while incorporating clean and aesthetic designs.

sections.label: Artistic Foundation
sections.title: From Traditional Art to Digital Design
sections.body: My journey as a designer began in early childhood, when I developed a passion for drawing and painting landscapes, flowers, animals, and portraits. Ever since my childhood I used to draw continuously with aquarelle, oil and acrylic colors. This artistic personality gives me a natural advantage in UI design, particularly in creating original and beautiful visual elements and understanding color theory and composition. Today, I continue to develop these skills digitally using my Wacom tablet with Adobe Illustrator, bringing the freedom of drawing art on paper to digital design.
